newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China to march troops into Hong Kong July 1 - FT.
newsitem.headline: China to march troops into Hong Kong July 1 - FT.

text.p: China plans to march 6,000 soldiers across the border into Hong Kong as it takes control of the territory at midnight on June 30, 1997, a newspaper report said on Thursday.
The Financial Times said in a report from London, that China informed British officials of its plans.
It said the show of military force, which will also include air and naval forces, is designed to emphasise China's sovereignty over Hong Kong after 150 years of British rule.
The newspaper said that British officials are concerned that the troop movements, expected to be seen on television around the world, will add to fears about how China will rule the territory.
The paper said that for a communist nation such as China a military display would be a natural part of such a handover.
Britain will have a formal farewell ceremony for its remaining troops at sundown on June 30.
